verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a single community report that Mixpanel offers group-level/account-level analytics for B2B SaaS, gated to higher price plans. No first-party docs describe how account-level funnels or retention work. missing for 10: first-party documentation of group/account analytics, evidence of account-level funnels and retention reports, plan availability details, hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can analyze behavior at the account or company level, not just per user, for B2B products

citations.quote: Group-level/account-level analytics useful for B2B SaaS is 'tucked away on one of Mixpanel's higher price plans,'
